name: agentscope
description: Explore and normalize traces from coding AI agents.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && pnpm --filter agentscope-web lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run mypy agentscope && pnpm --filter agentscope-web typecheck
